cardPool.title: Nihilego
cardPool.value:
Nihilego is an Ultra Beast that resembles a jellyfish. The bell is semi-translucent and encircled with several white, star-shaped markings. The wavy rim of the bell flares outward and is bright blue. Its tentacles appear gelatinous and give it a vaguely humanoid shape. Several tentacles mesh together forming the appearance of cape or long hair, while four shorter tentacles resemble shorter hair and arms. Two long tentacles make up the legs of the human shape. In addition to its shape, it is sometimes seen acting like a young girl.
Nihilego is a parasitic organism and, by latching onto one's head, is capable of injecting a neurotoxin that subtly alters the thoughts and actions of any human or Pokémon that becomes its host.
Nihilego is a dual Rock and Poison type, and it has no gender. Nihilego is the Ultra Beast and it code named as UB-01 Symbiont.

cardPool.title: Zygarde in 50% Form
cardPool.value: Zygarde is a Pokemon whose form depends on the percentage of its Cores and Cells gathered together. Zygarde 50% Forme has a serpentine body with green and black markings. Most of its back, head, and neck are black, while the underbelly and the tip of its tail are green. Its eyes are made of four green hexagons, similar to an insect with compound eyes, and there is a thin, white line down the center of its face. Across the back of its neck is a large frill made of five long, flat protrusions that each have two small, green hexagons on them. There are three short tendrils on either side of its chest; they are black on the right and green on the left. Its tail also ends in five tendrils. It has many small, green hexagon markings on its body capable of glowing. 50% Forme Zygarde is a dual Dragon and Ground type, and it has no gender. 50% Forme Zygarde is a Legendary Pokemon.

cardPool.title: Zygarde in 10% Form
cardPool.value: Zygarde is a Pokemon whose form depends on the percentage of its Cores and Cells gathered together. 10% Zygarde is created when a Zygarde Core combines with only 10% of the total Zygarde Cells. Zygarde 10% Forme has a relatively small canine body. It is primarily black with a green collar and a leash-like extension on its neck. Additional green markings include: two hexagon markings on its chest, a small hexagon over each eye, the area around its mouth, and its front left paw. There is an elongated, red hexagon marking attached to the collar marking. Its eyes are white hexagons with no discernible pupils and there is a thin, white line on its forehead. On each of its legs are hexagonal extensions: two on the back of each elbow, one behind each knee, and two on each hip. One of the hip extensions is longer than the other on each hip. Zygarde 10% Forme also has razor-sharp teeth. 10% Forme Zygarde is a dual Dragon and Ground type, and it has no gender. 10% Forme Zygarde is a Legendary Pokemon.

cardPool.title: Castform in Rainy Form
cardPool.value: Castform is an artificial Pokemon that changes appearance and attitude based on the weather. Its body is made of cells exactly like those of water molecules, causing its cellular structure to be chemically altered by temperature and humidity. Though not of its free will, Castform uses this ability to protect its tiny body. Regardless of the form it takes, it will always have a large, spherical head and a lighter colored mask-like marking over its eyes. When it is soaked in rain, it takes on its Rain Form. It has a dark gray lower half resembling a storm cloud. The head turns blue and resembles a raindrop. Its body is soft and slippery and seeps with water when compressed. Castform in Rainy weather is now a Water type, and it may be either male or female.

cardPool.title: Blacephalon
cardPool.value:
Blacephalon is a colorful, humanoid Ultra Beast. Its slender torso and wide hips are yellow with alternating blue and pink stripes. There is a white sphere in the middle of its body and another on its back in place of a tail. It has thin arms with white frills on its wrists and teardrop-shaped hands. The right arm is pink, while the left is blue. Each arm has a spherical bulge near the shoulder. Its legs are shaped like white high-heeled boots with curled toes. Each foot has a sphere on it: blue on the left and pink on the right. Around its neck is a white frill with a hole in the center.
Blacephalon's head is a white ball with a multitude of pink and blue dots, which are a collection of tiny sparks. On either side of the ball are stars that are blue on the outside, pink on the inside, and have yellow dot-like eyes on the center. The head is not attached to the body and can be removed for use as a weapon.
Blacephalon is a dual Fire and Ghost type, and it has no gender. Blacephalon is the Ultra Beast and it code named as UB Burst.

cardPool.title: Kartana
cardPool.value:
Kartana is a small Ultra Beast that resembles an origami human. It appears to be folded out of a sheet of paper which is white on one side and orange on the other. Its head is folded slightly inside its body and has a four-sided star in the center, but no discernible facial features. Its head opens and closes similar to a paper fortune teller and seems to function as both an eye and a mouth. On top of its head are two short antennae or horns that are wider at the top. It has long, thin arms that resemble katanas with a yellow, sheath-like structure around the upper area. The sheath connects to a red, slightly raised hexagon on its torso. Extending up and out from the base of each sheath are three yellow projections that are nearly as long as its arms. Its legs appear creased with areas of red visible along the edges.
Kartana is a dual Grass and Steel type, and it has no gender. Kartana is the Ultra Beast and it code named as UB-04 Blade.

cardPool.title: Celesteela
cardPool.value:
Celesteela is a large, vaguely humanoid Ultra Beast with a bodily construction that resembles a cross between a space shuttle and a bamboo shoot. It has a small, white head with a tiny mouth and a skinny neck with three segments. On top of its head is a gray structure resembling a hat with long, flowing hair underneath. The hair reaches midway down its body and is rimmed with bright blue. The "hat" has two small blue dots and four white spikes arranged in an X-shape. These spikes resemble decorative hair sticks. On the very top of its hat is a long gray horn similar to a drill bit. It has large, disembodied gray arms that resemble bamboo stalks. At the end of each arm is a ring of bright blue, fin-like projections and a collection of eight smaller, black bamboo shoots. Each smaller stalk has a bright blue ring with a small line extending back up the stalk.
Its main body is conical and resembles a dress with four overlapping layers. The shortest and outermost layer is the shortest and appears metallic, while the inner layers are each a lighter shade of green, progressively longer, and seem to be cloth or plant material. Underneath all the layers is a white body with a light gray crisscross pattern covering it and a bright blue ring along the base. Below the dress is what appears to be a collection of eight black bamboo stalks. On the bottom of each stalk is a bright blue ring with a small line extending back up the stalk; this causes the stalks to also resemble solid rocket boosters.
Celesteela is a dual Steel and Flying type, and it has no gender. Celesteela is the Ultra Beast and it code named as UB-04 Blaster.

cardPool.title: Poipole
cardPool.value:
Poipole is a small, purple Ultra Beast. It has a bipedal build with a large head and relatively small limbs with no visible digits. On its head are three spikes: one in the front and one on each side. A single gray needle protrudes from the top of its head and there are additional needles in the spikes on the sides of its head. It has oval eyes with a single eyelash-like spike above each; its mouth and eyes give off a cyan glow. It has a long, tapering tail with a single spine in the middle. While most of its body is dark purple, it has several fuchsia markings: at the tip of each head-spike, on its chest, on top of its head, and on its face.
Poipole is a Poison type, and it has no gender. Poipole is the Ultra Beast and it code named as UB Adhesive.

cardPool.title: Xurkitree
cardPool.value:
Xurkitree is a very tall Ultra Beast that resembles a vaguely humanoid mass of electrical wiring. Its "head" is a white, brightly glowing electric spark with numerous points and no visible face. Below its head is a mass of black cables for its torso and limbs; there are white bands resembling zip ties throughout its body as well. Its arms have ties where its shoulders, elbows, and wrists would be. The upper arms have two cables, while the lower have three. At the ends of its arms are copper structures that resemble hands, each with six flat "fingers". The legs have ties at the hips, knees, and ankles and are composed of four cables fused together for the whole length. The feet have four toes possessing "claws" of exposed copper; each foot has two fused toes pointing forward and two separate toes pointing backward. Finally, its tail has three ties and four cables, one of them loose in two sections.
Xurkitree is an Electric type, and it has no gender. Xurkitree is the Ultra Beast and it code named as UB-03 Lighting.

cardPool.title: Naganadel
cardPool.value:
Naganadel is an Ultra Beast that has both draconic and insectoid features. Its upper body is slender with thin arms and a long neck. The upper chest, neck, head, and arms are light purple, while its waist is dark purple with a fuchsia stripe on each side. Each shoulder has a long gray spike and each hand has three pinkish-purple claws. Running down each side of its neck is a dark purple stripe, which connects and forms a loop on its chest. The lower area of the loop is fuchsia and has a short, downward extension in the middle. At the end of its long neck is its head, which has a long, spiked crest on the top. On the sides of its mouth are a pair of curved, gray spikes that act as mandibles. Its glowing cyan eyes are conjoined, rimmed with fuchsia, and have a spiky crest on either side, which gives them a visor-like appearance. A pair of light purple wings sprout from the center of its back. These wings have a single fuchsia claw at the joint, two spikes along the wing-arm and darker purple membranes with fuchsia markings near the spikes.
Naganadel is a dual Poison and Dragon type, and it has no gender. Naganadel is the evolution of Poipole. Naganadel is the Ultra Beast and it code named as UB Stinger.

cardPool.title: Buzzwole
cardPool.value:
Buzzwole is an Ultra Beast that resembles a large, anthropomorphic mosquito. Its head is small and flat with a black ridge up the center. It has two red compound eyes with two black, spherical basal joints for its red and black antennae between them. Protruding from under these joints is a long, silver proboscis. It has many bulging muscles that appear to be sacs full of a red fluid with small white bubbles inside. There are three sacs on each arm, two on each leg, two on its chest, and several on its shoulders and down its back. Around its waist are three rings of smaller sacs. The muscles on its chest and some on its arms and waist have thin, grayish lines resembling tendons running across them. It has large, five-fingered hands with red knuckles and four pointed legs. There are several black spikes on its body: a small one on each side of its head, two on each shoulder, one on each elbow, and one on each leg. The portions of its body between its muscles are dark red or black. On its back are two pairs of pale orange wings with slightly darker veins.
Buzzwole is a dual Bug and Fighting type, and it has no gender. Buzzwole is the Ultra Beast and it code named as UB-02 Absorption.

cardPool.title: Pheromosa
cardPool.value:
Pheromosa is an Ultra Beast that resembles a feminine anthropomorphic cockroach. It is primarily white with a thin build. Its torso is composed of five thin discs that droop slightly downward. The widest disc makes up its shoulders, the second widest its hips, and the two smallest its chest and waist. There is a gold ovoid inside of the widest disc, where its long, thin neck protrudes from. Its arms and legs are also long and thin with gold joints. Its hands and feet are both composed of two golden claws. Pheromosa has a small, semi-flattened head with a yellow, crown-like structure on top. The two tallest points of the crown point to its long, thin antennae, which are white with small gold balls at the tips. Attached to the back of its head are two structures resembling insect wings. The wings are transparent, curve slightly inward, and reach nearly to the ground. It has narrow, purple eyes with bright blue pupils.
Pheromosa is a dual Bug and Fighting type, and it has no gender. Pheromosa is the Ultra Beast and it code named as UB-02 Beauty

cardPool.title: Oricorio in Pa'u Style
cardPool.value: Oricorio is an avian Pokemon that can change between four markedly different forms. The form it takes on depends on the kind of nectar it consumes. All forms have a light pink beak, thin legs, and dark eyes with white pupils. The feet have three toes in front and one in back, and the beak curves downward. If Pink Nectar is used on Oricorio, it will change into Pa'u Style. In its Pa'u Style, Oricorio has pink feathers. Its main body is a dark pink, while most of its other feathers are varying shades of pink. A fan of three feathers tips each wing: two light pink with a whitish-pink on in the center. On the top of its head is an arrangement of feathers resembling a headdress: a ring of fluffy, light pink feathers with larger, paler feathers standing up from the center. There is a larger, similar group of feathers around its waist like a skirt. Pa'u Style Oricorio uses its dance to focus its mind and increase its psychic power. Pa'u Style Oricorio is a dual Psychic and Flying type, and it may be either male or female.

cardPool.title: Kommo-o
cardPool.value:
Kommo-o is a bipedal, reptilian Pokémon with scaly armor, primarily gray with lighter gray, yellow, and red markings. It features a rounded, beak-like snout and small eyes that are mostly obscured by head armor. The tip of its snout has a patch of pale gray, and both jaws have small tooth-like spikes. Its head is adorned with an elaborate arrangement of scales, including a yellow oval scale with a red heart shape at the base, flanked by chains of circular scales—three red with yellow trim and one solid yellow.
From the back of its headdress extend three chains of plain yellow scales. Its long neck is covered with overlapping scales: a solid gray scale at the top, three larger gray scales with yellow rims, and a solid yellow scale at the bottom. A thick yellow stripe with a rounded projection runs across its chest, while its shoulders are adorned with tufts of spiky white feathers and overlapping gray scales.
Kommo-o has four chains of scales extending from behind its shoulders; the two foremost chains have a solid gray scale at the top followed by three yellow-edged scales, while the other two consist only of solid gray scales. The lower halves of its legs are dark gray, each knee marked with pale gray. Its hands have four yellow claws, and its feet have three. A line of slightly raised pale gray scales runs down its back to the middle of its tapering tail, which features three sets of loose scales near the tip. The lower two sets are solid yellow, while the set closest to the tip has gray centers. The very tip of its tail is pale gray. Kommo-o is a dual Dragon and Fighting type, and it may be either male or female. Kommo-o is the evolution of Hakamo-o. It is the final form of Jangmo-o.

cardPool.title: Poltchageist
cardPool.value:
Poltchageist is a Pokemon made of matcha tea powder that inhabits a tea caddy; specifically a kind used in the traditional Japanese tea ceremony. The tea caddy is primarily black and white, with a white lid, a sealed crack near the top, and a painted pattern resembling a face. Poltchageist is always seen carrying a chashaku, the tea scoop used to transfer tea powder into the tea bowl in the aforementioned tea ceremony. On top of its matcha body, just below its lid, is a yellow swirl pattern. Poltchageist has two separate forms: Counterfeit Form and Artisan Form. Telling either of these forms apart requires careful inspection; an Artisan Form Poltchageist bears a stamp of authenticity on the base of its caddy, while a Counterfeit Form Poltchageist lacks it.
Despite similar physical resemblance to the Sinistea, it is a completely separate species. Poltechageist is a dual Grass and Ghost type, and it has no gender.

cardPool.title: Sinistcha
cardPool.value:
Sinistcha is a Pokemon made of matcha tea. As such, its main body is entirely green, except for its mouth and swirly eyes, which are yellow in color. Its arms are thin and its hands have three digits, and it has two small legs. It inhabits a  chawan, a tea bowl used in the traditional Japanese tea ceremony. The chawan it inhabits is black and white, with a crack near the top and a swirling, face-like pattern on its side. Atop its head, Sinistcha wears a chasen (a bamboo whisk used to prepare and stir matcha tea), which is broken and missing a few of its teeth. Sinistcha has two separate forms: Unremarkable Form and Masterpiece Form. Telling either of these forms apart requires careful inspection; a Masterpiece Form Sinistcha bears a stamp of authenticity on the base of its chawan, while an Unremarkable Form Sinistcha lacks it.
Despite similar physical resemblance to the Polteageist, it is a completely separate species. Sinistcha is a dual Grass and Ghost type, and it has no gender. Sinistcha is the evolution of Poltchageist.

cardPool.title: Pokemon Trade
cardPool.value:
Pokemon Trade, also known as a Link Trade, is a process in which a Pokémon Trainer sends one of their Pokémon to another Trainer in exchange for one of the other Trainer's Pokémon.

Also some Pokémon only evolve after being traded.

cardPool.title: Trade Evolution
cardPool.value: Trade Evolution refers to the process of evolving a Pokémon by trading it to another trainer. Some Pokémon evolves automatically after being traded. Several Pokémon evolve by trade without any additional requirement, but several other Pokémon need to be holding a specific Evolution item in order to evolve. The item is consumed after the Evolution.

cardPool.title: Poke Dollar
cardPool.value:
The Poke Dollar, often simply referred to as money, is the primary currency used in every region in Pokemon World. Its symbol is a P with a double strikethrough.
It is primarily obtained as prize money from winning Pokémon battles against another Pokémon Trainer and used to buy items from Poke Marts. Most items have prices that are multiples of 100 or 1000.

cardPool.title: Levelball
cardPool.value: The Levelball is a spherical device that used for catching and storing Pokemon. It has a grey top-half with orange stripe and red V on it. Levelball makes it easier to catch Pokemon that are less experienced than your own Pokemon. If a Levelball is thrown at an untamed Pokemon, there is a chance that the Pokemon will be caught and stored in the Levelball.

cardPool.title: Lureball
cardPool.value: The Lureball is a spherical device that used for catching and storing Pokemon. It is characterized by a blue top with a red "V" going up the middle which is decorated by three, vertical, yellow lines. The Lureball are 3 times more likely to catch Pokemon than Pokeballs upon fishing. Otherwise it same as Pokeball. If a Lureball is thrown at an untamed Pokemon, there is a chance that the Pokemon will be caught and stored in the Lureball.

cardPool.title: Moonball
cardPool.value: The Moonball is a spherical device that used for catching and storing Pokemon. It has a blue and black top, with blue on the left side and black on the right meeting in a zig-zag pattern in the middle. On the top of the border of the two sides is a yellow crescent moon. The Moonball are 4 times more likely to catch Pokemon that can only evolve through use of the Moon Stone than Pokeballs. Otherwise it same as Pokeball. If a Moonball is thrown at an untamed Pokemon, there is a chance that the Pokemon will be caught and stored in the Moonball.

cardPool.title: Friendball
cardPool.value: The Friendball is a spherical device that used for catching and storing Pokemon. This ball has a green top decorated with four red dots slanting toward the center button on both sides of the vertical mid-line on the top half and a gold dot near the "top" part of the ball's top half as seen from the front. It is used to catch Pokemon as effective as a standard Pokeball. However, Pokemon captured by this ball will be more friendlier than before. If a Friendball is thrown at an untamed Pokemon, there is a chance that the Pokemon will be caught and stored in the Friendball.

cardPool.title: Loveball
cardPool.value: The Loveball is a spherical device that used for catching and storing Pokemon. The Loveball is characterized by a pink top with a white heart going up the middle. The Loveball are 8 times more likely to catch Pokemon than Pokeballs when it used on same species of Pokemon but opposite gender. Otherwise it same as Pokeball. If a Loveball is thrown at an untamed Pokemon, there is a chance that the Pokemon will be caught and stored in the Loveball.

cardPool.title: Heavyball
cardPool.value: The Heavyball is a spherical device that used for catching and storing Pokemon. It has a dark blue top with lighter blue circles on either side at an angle from the central button, the top most of which is the largest and the lower-most of which are tiny and almost the same shade of blue as the majority of the top. The heavier the Pokemon, the more likely it is to catch. If a Heavyball is thrown at an untamed Pokemon, there is a chance that the Pokemon will be caught and stored in the Heavyball.

cardPool.title: Fastball
cardPool.value: The Fastball is a spherical device that used for catching and storing Pokemon. It is characterized by yellow half-circles on the sides of both the top and bottom halves, with the top half being primarily red and carrying a lightning-bolt yellow mark on the very top. The Fastball are 4 times more likely to catch Pokemon than Pokeballs when it used on fast Pokemons. Otherwise it same as Pokeball. If a Fastball is thrown at an untamed Pokemon, there is a chance that the Pokemon will be caught and stored in the Fastball.

cardPool.title: Repeatball
cardPool.value: The Repeatball is a spherical device that used for catching and storing Pokemon. Its distinguishing features consist of a red top similar to a normal Poké Ball, with a gold and continuing series of connected circles starting from the button and ending at the rear of the top half. The open spaces of each circle are colored black. The Repeatball are 3 times more likely to catch Pokemon than Pokeballs, when it used for catching Pokemon that have been caught before. Otherwise it same as Pokeball. If a Repeatball is thrown at an untamed Pokemon, there is a chance that the Pokemon will be caught and stored in the Repeatball.

cardPool.title: Duskball
cardPool.value: The Duskball is a spherical device that used for catching and storing Pokemon. It looks like a black ball with large dark green circles on each sides. It has an orange button to push for sending the Pokemon out.  The Duskball are 3 times more likely to catch Pokemon than Pokeballs when it used in dark places or at night. Otherwise it same as Pokeball. If a Duskball is thrown at an untamed Pokemon, there is a chance that the Pokemon will be caught and stored in the Duskball.

cardPool.title: Timerball
cardPool.value: The Timerball is a spherical device that used for catching and storing Pokemon. It has a black, white, and red top with the sides of the top half being black also along with what looks like a cooking timer type handle in orange pointing toward the button. The longer the battle with a wild Pokemon lasts, the more likely it is to catch. If a Timerball is thrown at an untamed Pokemon, there is a chance that the Pokemon will be caught and stored in the Timerball.

cardPool.title: Nestball
cardPool.value: The Nestball is a spherical device that used for catching and storing Pokemon. It has a green top with yellow or brown bands that wrap from the sides up around the back before ending in a circle at the top to make a woven nest. The Nestball are more likely to catch Pokemon than Pokeballs when it used on weaker Pokemon. Otherwise it same as Pokeball. If a Nestball is thrown at an untamed Pokemon, there is a chance that the Pokemon will be caught and stored in the Nestball.

cardPool.title: Netball
cardPool.value: The Netball is a spherical device that used for catching and storing Pokemon. It has a light blue top with black bands crossing it in a "net" pattern, often raised above the ball's surface. The Netball are 3.5 times more likely to catch Water and/or Bug type Pokemon than Pokeballs. Otherwise it same as Pokeball.  If a Netball is thrown at an untamed Pokemon, there is a chance that the Pokemon will be caught and stored in the Netball.

cardPool.title: Diveball
cardPool.value: The Diveball is a spherical device that used for catching and storing Pokemon. The entire ball is various shades blue except for the black horizontal band around the middle, and a white "cap" on the top of the ball in which the blue forms a gentle "wave" pattern around. The Diveball are 3.5 times more likely to catch Pokemon than Pokeballs, when it used on or under water. Otherwise it same as Pokeball.  If a Diveball is thrown at an untamed Pokemon, there is a chance that the Pokemon will be caught and stored in the Diveball.

cardPool.title: Luxuryball
cardPool.value: The Luxuryball is a spherical device that used for catching and storing Pokemon. The Luxury Ball is almost entirely black with a gold band around the middle as well as a gold button, and carries rings of red on both halves which themselves are flanked by rings of gold. It is used to catch Pokemon as effective as a standard Pokeball. However, a Pokemon caught in this ball will form a bond with its trainer more quickly. It’s very popular for rich trainers. If a Luxuryball is thrown at an untamed Pokemon, there is a chance that the Pokemon will be caught and stored in the Luxuryball.

cardPool.title: Healball
cardPool.value: The Healball is a spherical device that used for catching and storing Pokemon. The Healball is a mostly pink with tan shapes on it going from the bottom of the Healball to slightly above the blue ring that goes horizontally across the ball. It has a purple button to push for sending the Pokemon out. It is used to catch Pokemon as effective as a standard Pokeball. However, Pokemon captured by this ball will be fully healed, hence its name. If a Healball is thrown at an untamed Pokemon, there is a chance that the Pokemon will be caught and stored in the Healball.

cardPool.title: Quickball
cardPool.value: The Quickball is a spherical device that used for catching and storing Pokemon. Appearance wise, Quickballs are blue with wild yellow stripes and a misshapen triangle formation in the middle. The Quickball are 5 times more likely to catch Pokemon than Pokeballs when it used at the very beginning of the Wild Pokemon encounter. Otherwise it same as Pokeball. If a Quickball is thrown at an untamed Pokemon, there is a chance that the Pokemon will be caught and stored in the Quickball.

cardPool.title: Dreamball
cardPool.value: The Dreamball is a spherical device that used for catching and storing Pokemon. It has a pink and dark pink pattern on top of the capsule and a misty purple and white on the bottom half of the capsule. The Dreamball are 4 times more likely to catch Pokemon than Pokeballs when it used on a sleeping Pokemon. Otherwise it same as Pokeball. If a Dreamball is thrown at an untamed Pokemon, there is a chance that the Pokemon will be caught and stored in the Dreamball.

cardPool.title: Beastball
cardPool.value: The Beastball is a spherical device created by Aether Foundation that specifically designed for catching and storing Ultra Beasts rather than on Pokemon. The Beast Ball is a blue ball with two rings surrounding it on each side diagonally. The Beastball are 5 times more likely to catch Ultra Beast than Pokeballs, otherwise it struggles to catch any other Pokemon. If a Beastball is thrown at an untamed Pokemon, there is a chance that the Pokemon will be caught and stored in the Beastball.

cardPool.title: Ultra Beast
cardPool.value:
The Ultra Beasts are a group of extradimensional Pokemon originating from Ultra Space. They possess power that transcends humans' understanding of the world.
Ultra Beasts infrequently appear from Ultra Wormholes. These appearances are apparently as unexpected for the Ultra Beasts as for people, which tends to make them combative. They are especially drawn to people who have passed through an Ultra Wormhole, due to the residual wormhole energy on them, apparently expecting to find a wormhole they can use to return home.
All Pokeballs except Masterballs and Beastballs have a very low catch rate.

cardPool.title: Pokemon Daycare
cardPool.value: A Pokemon Day Care is a place for Pokemon Trainers to drop off their Pokémon to be raised in the care of other people. Where it is possible to leave two Pokemon, it is also possible for them to breed and produce Eggs.

cardPool.title: Full Restore
cardPool.value: Full Restore is a spray-type medicine that can be used to fully restore Pokémon's health and cure any status conditions it may have.

cardPool.title: Revive
cardPool.value: Revive is a yellow medicine shaped like an elongated octahedron. It revives a single fainted Pokémon to half of its health.

cardPool.title: Max Revive
cardPool.value: Max Revive is a yellow medicine shaped like a stellated octahedron. It completely revives a single fainted Pokémon.

cardPool.title: Heal Powder
cardPool.value: Heal Powder is a green medical powder that heals Pokemon from status conditions such as burn, paralysis, poison, sleep, freeze and confusion. However, its taste is very unpleasant and decreases Pokemon’s friendship.

cardPool.title: Energy Powder
cardPool.value: Energy Powder is a beige medical powder that heals wounded Pokemon slightly. However, its taste is very unpleasant and decreases Pokemon’s friendship.

cardPool.title: Energy Root
cardPool.value: Energy Root is a medical root shaped like a muscular arm that greatly heals the wounded Pokemon. However, its taste is very unpleasant and decreases Pokemon’s friendship

cardPool.title: Revival Herb
cardPool.value: Revival Herb is a green medical herb that fully revives a single fainted Pokemon. However, its taste is very unpleasant and decreases Pokemon’s friendship.

cardPool.title: Soothe Bell
cardPool.value: Soothe Bell is small round silver bell. Its comforting chime calms the Pokemon who's holding this bell, making it friendly towards its Trainer.

cardPool.title: Eviolite
cardPool.value: Eviolite is a smooth purplish stone that boosts the Defense and Special Defense of a Pokémon that holds it if the holder is not fully evolved.

cardPool.title: Lucky Egg
cardPool.value: Lucky Egg is a special egg-shaped item that gains extra Exp. Points in battle if Pokemon holding it.

cardPool.title: Exp. Share
cardPool.value: Exp. Share is a special black helmet-like device with a silver trim around the base, the earpieces and yellow orbs are embedded in the top of the dome. Turning on this special device will allow all the Pokémon on your team to receive Exp. Points from battles.

cardPool.title: Leftovers
cardPool.value: Leftovers are an item looks like an apple core. While Pokemon holds this item, it’s slowly but steadily heals throughout a battle.

cardPool.title: Iron
cardPool.value: Iron is a nutritious drink for Pokemon that raises the Defense base points of a single Pokemon.

cardPool.title: HP Up
cardPool.value: HP Up  is a nutritious drink for Pokemon that raises the HP base points of a single Pokemon.

cardPool.title: Protein
cardPool.value: Protein is a nutritious drink for Pokemon that raises the Attack base points of a single Pokemon.

cardPool.title: Calcium
cardPool.value: Calcium is a nutritious drink for Pokemon that raises the Special Attack base points of a single Pokemon.

cardPool.title: Zinc
cardPool.value: Zinc is a nutritious drink for Pokemon that raises the Special Defense base points of a single Pokemon.

cardPool.title: Carbos
cardPool.value: Carbos is a nutritious drink for Pokemon that raises the Speed base points of a single Pokemon.

cardPool.title: Rare Candy
cardPool.value: Rare Candy is a special candy that is filled with energy, packed in a blue wrapper. If Pokemon consumes the Rare Candy, it raises its level by one.

cardPool.title: Exp. Candy XS
cardPool.value: Exp. Candy XS is a very small pyramid candy that is filled with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a very small amount of Exp. Points.

cardPool.title: Exp. Candy S
cardPool.value: Exp. Candy S is a small pyramid candy that is filled with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a small amount of Exp. Points.

cardPool.title: Exp. Candy M
cardPool.value: Exp. Candy M is a medium-sized cubic candy that is filled with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a moderate amount of Exp. Points.

cardPool.title: Exp. Candy L
cardPool.value: Exp. Candy L is a large elongated octahedron candy that is filled with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a large amount of Exp. Points.

cardPool.title: Exp. Candy XL
cardPool.value: Exp. Candy XL is a very large elongated octahedron candy that is filled with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a very large amount of Exp. Points.

cardPool.title: Power Weight
cardPool.value: Power Weight is a green special weight that gives an extra HP effort values to Pokemon who holding this item but halves its Speed as side effect.

cardPool.title: Power Bracer
cardPool.value: Power Bracer is a red special bracer that gives an extra Attack effort values to Pokemon who holding this item but halves its Speed as side effect.

cardPool.title: Power Belt
cardPool.value: Power Belt is an orange special belt that gives an extra Defense effort values to Pokemon who holding this item but halves its Speed as side effect.

cardPool.title: Power Lens
cardPool.value: Power Lens is a purple special lens that gives an extra Special Attack effort values to Pokemon who holding this item but halves its Speed as side effect.

cardPool.title: Power Band
cardPool.value: Power Band is a yellow special band that gives an extra Special Defense effort values to Pokemon who holding this item but halves its Speed as side effect.

cardPool.title: Power Anklet
cardPool.value: Power Anklet is a cyan special anklet that gives an extra Speed effort values to Pokemon who holding this item but halves its Speed as side effect.

cardPool.title: Pokerus
cardPool.value: Pokérus is a microscopic, virus-like life-form that can infect Pokémon, though it is completely harmless to them. Once infected, a Pokémon gains double the Effort Values (EVs) from battles. However, EVs obtained from items like Vitamins and Feathers are unaffected. The infected Pokémon can spread Pokérus to others for one to four days, though this timer can be extended by storing the Pokémon in a PC Box.

cardPool.title: Omni Ring
cardPool.value: The Omni Ring is an advanced, bracelet-like device with a sleek white, gold, and black design. It integrates the functions of multiple battle-enhancing items—including the Key Stone, Z-Ring, Dynamax Band, and Tera Orb—into a single piece of equipment.

cardPool.title: Moomoo Milk
cardPool.value: Moomoo Milk is sweet and highly nutritious milk that comes from Miltank's udder. It heals the Pokémon and ill or weary humans. Additionally, it is widely used as an ingredient in cooking and for producing various dairy products.

cardPool.title: Honey
cardPool.value: Honey is a sweet and viscous substance gathered from by some bee-like Pokemon, such as Combee and Cuteyfly. Beside of using it as a food and sweets, it also used to attract wild Pokémon when it is used in tall grass, in caves, or on special trees.

cardPool.title: Mega-Venusaur
cardPool.value:
Venusaur can Mega Evolve into Mega-Venusaur using the Venusaurite.
When Mega Evolved, the flower on Venusaur's back grows larger, and two smaller pink flowers bloom, one on its forehead and one on its rear. Its legs and back have become sturdier to support the extra weight of the flower. Additional leaves with woody stems, which are supported by vines, are also grown around the flower. Mega Venusaur also develops dark markings on its forehead below the new flower on its forehead.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Grass and Poison type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Charizard X
cardPool.value:
Charizard can Mega Evolve into Mega Charizard X using the Charizardite X. 
As Mega-Charizard X, its body and legs are more physically fit, though its arms remain thin. Its skin turns black with a sky-blue underside and soles. Two spikes with blue tips curve upward from the front and back of each shoulder, while the tips of its horns sharpen, turn blue, and curve slightly upward. Its brow and claws are larger, and its eyes are now red. It has two small, fin-like spikes under each horn and two more down its lower neck. The finger disappears from the wing membrane, and the lower edges are divided into large, rounded points. The third joint of each wing-arm is adorned with a claw-like spike. Mega Charizard X breathes blue flames out the sides of its mouth, and the flame on its tail now burns blue consistently. 
When it Mega Evolved, its type changed into dual Fire and Dragon type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Charizard Y
cardPool.value:
Charizard can Mega Evolve into Mega-Charizard Y using the Charizardite Y. 
As Mega Charizard Y, it becomes sleeker in appearance but retains its normal coloration. It has three pointed horns on the back of its head, the middle of which is longer. Its snout has larger fangs and a ridge on the nose. Its neck is shorter, but its torso is thinner and longer. It features longer digitigrade feet. Its hands are less developed, with extremely shortened fingers that are no longer separated from each other. Small wings develop on its wrists, while the ones on its back become larger, lose the wing finger passing through their membrane and end up with ragged edges. The back of its tail has a large spike at the base and three smaller ones near the tip, which now burns with a longer flame. 
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Fire and Flying type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Blastoise
cardPool.value:
Blastoise can Mega Evolve into Mega-Blastoise using the Blastoisinite. 
When Mega Evolved, Blastoise develops two smaller shells over its arms, each with their own water cannon. The two cannons on its back are replaced by a single, central water cannon of greater size that can retract into its shell. This cannon extends forward over Mega Blastoise's head and is said to have a blast range of over 6 miles (10 kilometers). Small ridges develop over its now-red eyes and extend to its ears. The ears angle slightly backward and there is a small point on its chin. 
When it Mega Evolved, it remains Water type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Beedrill
cardPool.value:
Beedrill can Mega Evolve into Mega-Beedrill using the Beedrillite. 
As Mega-Beedrill, it gains more defined features. The antennae are shorter and T-shaped. Its eyes become longer and sleeker. It now has three pairs of wings; the uppermost pair is larger with black trim along the top. Its stingers become longer and larger, resembling lances. Additional conical, black-and-yellow stingers with white tips take the place of its legs. Its abdomen becomes larger, grooved, and is attached to its thorax by a black structure. A similar black structure connects its head and thorax. The stinger on its abdomen is now a pale yellow, and it now has black stripes over its entire body. 
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Bug and Poison type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Pidgeot
cardPool.value:
Pidgeot can Mega Evolve into Mega-Pidgeot using the Pidgeotite. 
Pidgeot grows noticeably when it Mega Evolves, developing a larger body and longer, broader wings. Its wingtips and tail feathers are tipped with cyan, and its cream coloring is now white. Its eyes turn magenta and its pupils turn white. Mega Pidgeot has an even more elaborate crest on its head, with a streamer-like magenta plume extending from a mane of yellow feathers. A magenta feather projects from the front of its crest and there is a single magenta highlight on the left side. 
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Normal and Flying type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Alakazam
cardPool.value:
Alakazam can Mega Evolve into Mega-Alakazam using the Alakazite. 
As Mega Alakazam, its mustache turns white and becomes longer and bushier. It also grows a long, white beard. The armor-like sections become bulkier, and its upper body section becomes slightly shorter to reveal its thin stomach. The ear-like spikes become slightly shorter and a larger spike forms on top of its head. Additionally, it gains an oval, red organ in the center of its forehead. The organ is said to emit psychic power. Its lower legs become longer and slimmer and its feet become skinnier and resemble talons. It gains three additional spoons, for a total of five that it levitates in the air. 
When it Mega Evolved, it remains Psychic type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Slowbro
cardPool.value:
Slowbro can Mega Evolve into Mega-Slowbro using the Slowbronite. 
As Mega Slowbro, it becomes engulfed by the Shellder so that only its head, arms, and white-tipped tail are visible. Its head pokes out of the Shellder's mouth and is surrounded by the Shellder's enlarged teeth. The Shellder has holes on its sides and an opening at its tip, allowing Mega Slowbro's arms and tail to stick out. Mega Slowbro balances on its tail due to its legs being engulfed. It can move by bouncing, using its tail as a spring. The spikes on the Shellder are now reduced to four on the bottom section of its body and the dark spots only visible on its middle section. 
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Water and Psychic type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Gengar
cardPool.value:
Gengar can Mega Evolve into Mega-Gengar using the Gengarite. 
As Mega Gengar, a portion of its body sinks into the ground and its arms and tail lengthen. The lower portions turn a more reddish-purple, and a third eye appears on its forehead. This new unblinking eye is oval, yellow, and allows it to see into other dimensions. The spikes on Mega Gengar's back are more numerous and pointed, and additional spikes appear on its hands and tail. Its ears are now considerably longer and tilt backward. 
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Ghost and Poison type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Kangaskhan
cardPool.value:
Kangaskhan can Mega Evolve into Mega-Kangaskhan using the Kangaskhanite.
As Mega Kangaskhan, the mother Kangaskhan appears unchanged. However, the baby temporarily grows and gains some new features. There are now raised patches on its knees similar to those seen on its mother. These patches also appear aligned horizontally along its waist with a larger patch on its belly. Small, spiked growths appear underneath its ears.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains Normal type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Pinsir
cardPool.value:
Pinsir can Mega Evolve into Mega-Pinsir using the Pinsirite.  
As Mega Pinsir, it gains a large pair of clear, yellow wings with an area of orange venation near the base. Additionally, a set of brown elytra appear. Slicing through each elytron is a pair of orange blades. Its arms become longer and it has a T-shaped spike on each forearm. The pincers on its head are now longer with larger spikes, and its eyes are now yellow. 
When it Mega Evolved, its type changed into dual Bug and Flying type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Gyarados
cardPool.value:
Gyarados can Mega Evolve into Mega-Gyarados using the Gyaradosite. 
When it Mega Evolves, Gyarados becomes bulkier. The fins on its cheeks become longer and gain a yellow tint. Its crest is larger and black, and its barbels also gain considerable length. A large spike extends downward underneath its chin, and it now has a black underside with a red stripe around the edges. The yellow spots along its body are replaced by raised red scales, which propel Mega Gyarados through the water. Two large yellow fins with blue spines appear on its back. Most of the other fins along its back disappear, replaced by two rows of blue spikes. There are now four yellowish, spiky fins near its tail: two on its back and two on its underside. 
When it Mega Evolved, its type changed into dual Water and Dark type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Aerodactyl
cardPool.value:
Aerodactyl can Mega Evolve into Mega-Aerodactyl using the Aerodactylite.  As Mega Aerodactyl, its eyes turn bright green and parts of its body turn to stone, which some researchers believe to be its original appearance before fossilization. It grows larger and sprouts jagged black spiky rocks all over its body: five spikes at the wrist joint of each wing replacing its hands, three small spikes along its tail, one spike on each ear, and a long spike on its chin. The spike on its back and its rear talons have also become black and stony. Rocky plates cover its eyebrows and the corners of its jaw. Similar stone ornaments are present on its chest on its torso: two small ridges flanking a longer ridge.
 When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Rock and Flying type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Mewtwo X
cardPool.value: Mewtwo can Mega Evolve into Mega-Mewtwo X using the Mewtwonite X. Mega Mewtwo X is larger and bulkier than its normal state. The horns on its head are longer and extend from V-shaped ridges on its forehead. Additionally, the horns are now pointed and curve upward. It now has two tubes behind its neck, its eyes are light blue, and it has large, purple growths over its shoulders. Its torso is smooth and small compared to its long, bulky limbs, and a Y-shaped line connects the collar and underbelly. Its forearms and thighs each have two raised ridges and its digits are now longer and thinner. Its tail is slightly shorter and stiffer than before and has a curled tip. Its muscles are augmented with psychic power, giving it a grip strength of one ton and the ability to sprint 100 meters in two seconds. When using moves in battle, it is shown to be able to stretch its arms and legs. When it Mega Evolved, its type changed into dual Psychic and Fighting type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Mewtwo Y
cardPool.value: Mewtwo can Mega Evolve into Mega-Mewtwo Y using the Mewtwonite Y. Mega Mewtwo Y is smaller and lighter, losing its long tail and the tube behind its neck. However, it grows a long, purple appendage with a curled tip from the back of its head that is similar to its previous form's tail. On its head, it has two pointed, backward-curving spikes and a half-ring structure connecting to the base of each and crossing over the top of its head. Its eyes are now red and slightly larger. The digits on its hands and feet are now purple and more bulbous and the middle toe is longer than the others. A bumpy ridge similar to a sternum replaces the breastplate structure on its chest, but this form is still largely smoother than the other two. When it Mega Evolved, it remains Psychic type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Ampharos
cardPool.value:
Ampharos can Mega Evolve into Mega-Ampharos using the Ampharosite.
As Mega Ampharos, its toes turn black and it regrows white wool at the back of its head and over its tail, having its genes stimulated by Mega Evolution. This energy also awakens its long-sleeping dragon blood. Its long wooly tail has many small, red orbs attached to it. Its conical ears retain their stripes but are now segmented with swirled tips.
When it Mega Evolved, its type changed into dual Electric and Dragon type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Steelix
cardPool.value:
Steelix can Mega Evolve into Mega-Steelix using the Steelixite. 
As Mega Steelix, its body becomes longer, almost doubles its mass, and gains more features. Mega Steelix's eyes turn blue and its lower jaw becomes more heavily armored with a round, curved shape. Additionally, a third pair of ridges appear on its bottom jaw, as well as two sharp, flat structures consisting of three conjoined projections on each side. The gray, rock-like spikes and its tail point have transformed into prism-like crystalline spikes; the segments from which the spikes protrude are much larger as well. In-between the head and individual spiked segments are smaller units, now adorned by a black spot with a blue hexagon on each side. Several metallic-looking scraps constantly rotate around its neck; these scraps react to Mega Steelix's movements and change position when attacking.
 When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Steel and Ground type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Scizor
cardPool.value:
Scizor can Mega Evolve into Mega-Scizor using the Scizorite.
Mega Scizor's pincers lengthen and develop serrations. The lower half of the pincers turn white and gain three-pointed spikes on the underside. The barbs on Mega Scizor's pincers can stab through concrete, and opponents caught in them cannot escape. Its eyespots, along with its actual eyes, are now blue; the former additionally gains a black rim. Additional pieces of black armoring appear on various areas of its body: a three-pointed crest on its forehead and striated coverings on its shoulders and thighs. Mega Scizor's legs are less detailed and resemble large, tapered spikes with white tips.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Bug and Steel type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Heracross
cardPool.value:
Heracross can Mega Evolve into Mega-Heracross using the Heracronite.
Mega Heracross is bulkier than its previous form. Thin orange markings now rim its head, hands, and shoulders. Additionally, there is a half-circle, orange marking over its eyes. It now has a long, pointed nose that curves slightly upward. Its back now lacks wings and is completely yellow. The horn on its head has grown into a large, simple spike with two smaller spikes on the front. The antennae have lengthened as well and now have ovoid tips. Mega Heracross's forearms have thickened and lost their spines.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Bug and Fighting type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Houndoom
cardPool.value:
Houndoom can Mega Evolve into Mega-Houndoom using the Houndoominite.
As Mega Houndoom, the ridges on its back thicken, and it gains additional bone-like rings around the base of its tail. The rings on its tail have small spikes on top resembling vertebrae. The ridge at the base of Mega Houndoom's neck is longer and curves forward towards its shoulders. Instead of a band with a skull pendant, there is a large, toothed structure around its neck. This bone-like formation has two large spikes on either side and three pointed teeth on the bottom. Mega Houndoom's horns now point straight up with a small, outward curve in the middle. The two bands on its hind legs have vanished, and those on its forelegs are broken in the front.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Dark and Fire type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Tyranitar
cardPool.value:
Tyranitar can Mega Evolve into Mega-Tyranitar using the Tyranitarite.
 Mega Tyranitar's armor becomes more fragmented, with four new triangular gaps along its neck and one on its throat. The chest holes widen, the top two now housing glowing red ovals. Its neck spikes shorten, while those on its head lengthen into sharp, pronounced brow ridges. The central spike extends into a tall, upright horn.
Its chest plate expands, curving over its shoulders and back to form three jagged spikes on each side. The once-blue belly scales turn a vivid red, seething with raw energy—signifying its heightened power. Two sharp knee spikes emerge, and its leg joints become more pronounced. Its tail elongates, with the three spikes at the tip flaring outward. Most strikingly, its back splits open from the sheer force of Mega Evolution.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Rock and Dark type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Sceptile
cardPool.value:
Sceptile can Mega Evolve into Mega-Sceptile using the Sceptilite.  As Mega Sceptile, its head crests become more pointed with a round portion missing from the middle. Red marking surrounds its eyes, which become smaller and more narrow. The yellow seeds down its back grow larger. The last pair of seeds turn red, while the pair above it turns orange. Red stripes encircle the base of its tail and run across its lower belly. The leaves on its wrists become more pointed, and the upper ones have red tips and half-circles cut out of the middles. Covering its chest and shoulders are plates of leaves similar to those that form its tail. Mega Sceptile's tail grows longer and develops a red stinger at the tip.
When it Mega Evolved, its type changed into dual Grass and Dragon type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Blaziken
cardPool.value:
Blaziken can Mega Evolve into Mega-Blaziken using the Blazikenite.
As Mega Blaziken, it loses its yellow markings and gains black markings on its upper legs and chest. Its hair-like feathers take on a wing-like shape and point upward, and the portion around its chest is rough around its shoulders. The crest on its head changes into a flat horn that curves backward. The fire it creates on its wrists is now longer.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Fire and Fighting type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Swampert
cardPool.value:
Swampert can Mega Evolve into Mega-Swampert using the Swampertite.
As Mega Swampert, this Pokemon gains considerable bulk. Its upper body and arms become more muscular, bulging compared to its squat lower body. The orange padding on Swampert's thighs vanish, but it gains two additional patches of orange padding on each wrist and another patch on each shoulder. This padding and its gills become a darker, redder shade of orange, while the gills are now larger and bulbous, with filaments extending past its mouth. The black fins on its head are thicker and now extend down past its shoulders. The black tail fin is still shaped like an upward-turned fan, but it now forms a short ridge that extends up to this Pokémon's forehead, flanked on either side by the aforementioned head-fins. The webbed digits on Mega Swampert's "hands" take on a black color and now feature better defined articulations.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Water and Ground type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Gardevoir
cardPool.value:
Gardevoir can Mega Evolve into Mega-Gardevoir using the Gardevoirite.
As Mega Gardevoir, it turns almost completely white; only its hair remains green. Its gown becomes longer and wider, resembling a bridal gown. The forearms are slightly thicker with a pointed extension above the elbow, resembling gloves. Its facial spikes are larger and now curl upwards. In contrast, its hair is now shorter and more tightly curled. There are now two horns in the center of its chest, extending to either side.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Psychic and Fairy type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Sableye
cardPool.value:
Sableye can Mega Evolve into Mega-Sableye using the Sablenite.
As Mega Sableye, being bathed in Mega Evolution energy causes the red jewel on its chest to rip out of Sableye's skin and significantly increase in size; the detached jewel leaves a small hole in Mega Sableye's chest. Its ears elongate, and it gains a spike on the top of its head. Its teeth turn from white to yellow, and its eyes also change from pale blue to crimson red, with diagonal slits at their inner edges. Its back gains more gems: a second green one, a second red one, and two small yellow gems.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains Dark and Ghost type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Mawile
cardPool.value:
Mawile can Mega Evolve into Mega-Mawile using the Mawilite.
Mega Mawile has two sets of jaws protruding from the back of its head, and both sets have a spiky tuft of hair. It also seems to be able to control the jaws independently of one another. The ear-like extensions on its head are longer and have tips with two points. Its legs have grown longer, and its "hakama" is now magenta. Its arms now resemble thick sleeves, with magenta markings around the wrists.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Steel and Fairy type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Aggron
cardPool.value:
Aggron can Mega Evolve into Mega-Aggron using the Aggronite.
Mega Aggron is bulkier and more heavily plated than its previous state. The horns on its forehead are now shorter, and it has a third, wider horn on its nose. A spike projects downward from both its upper and lower jaw. The protrusions on its shoulders are longer and curve toward its head, and new spikes thrust from holes in its armbands. Its tail is thicker with two bands around it.
When it Mega Evolved, its type changed into pure Steel type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Medicham
cardPool.value:
Medicham can Mega Evolve into Mega-Medicham using the Medichamite.
As Mega Medicham, its headpiece now resembles a white turban with a yellow stone in the center. The red extension in the back is retained, and there are five white extensions on the turban, three extending from the stone and one on either side of its head. There is now a gold band on each wrist and additional gold bands around its waist. Several blue, teardrop-shaped decorations hang from the lowest hip band. Using its enhanced willpower, Mega Medicham has formed four ghost-like arms around itself. The more trained its spirit, the more realistic and dexterous its self-created arms become.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains Fighting and Psychic type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Manectric
cardPool.value: Manectric can Mega Evolve into Mega-Manectric using the Manectite.  The yellow mane on Mega Manectric is considerably larger than its previous state. The center spike on its head has shifted, and now forms a large, tilted growth that extends over its snout and has a point on either end. The remaining two head spikes are thinner, longer, and have small, pointed bulbs in place of the earholes. The mane now extends down the length of Mega Manectric's body, forming four additional spikes. One of these spikes extends down past the Pokémon's chest and has points on both ends. The tufts of fur on its haunches are now blue and form more numerous, thinner points. While it retains the yellow tufts around its front feet, they now have two short spikes extending backward. Finally, Mega Manectric lacks the sharply angled tail of its previous state and now has red claws. When it Mega Evolved, it remains Electric type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Sharpedo
cardPool.value:
Sharpedo can Mega Evolve into Mega-Sharpedo using the Sharpedonite.
As Mega Sharpedo, the fangs in its mouth have transformed, and the horns that have sprouted from its nose are fangs that are retractable, and can be regrown countless times. In addition, its body is also covered with yellow patterns.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains Water and Dark type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Camerupt
cardPool.value:
Camerupt can Mega Evolve into Mega-Camerupt using the Cameruptite.
As Mega Camerupt, the humps on its back have transformed into one large and very active volcano. Its fur expands and grows to a point where only its hooves can be seen, and its ears and the tufts on its head grow thicker and longer, standing on end. It gains a gray M on the front of its face and loses the three blue rings on its body. Magma is constantly bubbling up from within its body.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Fire and Ground type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Altaria
cardPool.value:
Altaria can Mega Evolve into Mega-Altaria using the Altarianite.
Mega Altaria has more extensive cloud-like plumage, with a large, fluffy mass extending from its back. The feathers have grown as a self-protective measure, and they glimmer with an iridescent sheen. Its cottony wings are more distinct than in its base form, and its blue belly is now exposed. Additional fluff surrounds its neck like a collar, and its head is adorned with a hat-like crest. A single, small feather curls out from its forehead, though its facial features are unchanged. Its tail feathers have grown into a long, wavy streamer, with three longer central plumes.
When it Mega Evolved, its type changed into dual Dragon and Fairy type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Banette
cardPool.value:
Banette can Mega Evolve into Mega-Banette using the Banettite.
As Mega Banette, this Pokemon gains several additional zippers: one running diagonally across its face, one on each hand, and another on its body. The first zipper runs from its left eye to the tip of its central spike. The other three are all unzipped, revealing parts of Mega Banette's cursed purple body. Its three long purple fingers and body revealing two pointed, purple legs are visible. Its zigzagging ribbon becomes somewhat erect, and now has two zipper rings around it and a short zipper on the tip. It gains four further spikes: one on the top and bottom of each hand and one on each hip. However, it loses its brush-like tail.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains Ghost type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Absol
cardPool.value:
Absol can Mega Evolve into Mega-Absol using the Absolite.
As Mega Absol, its fur is longer overall, and the increased energy coursing through its body makes the fur at the back of its mane stand on end so that it appears to have wings. The spikes on its heels and elbows grow larger, and the fur in these areas becomes longer as well. Its sickle-shaped horn widens, while an additional, smaller horn appears on the opposite side of its head. Its tail now has a more saw-like shape, and the oval marking on its forehead is now a rounded triangle.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains Dark type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Glalie
cardPool.value:
Glalie can Mega Evolve into Mega-Glalie using the Glalitite.
Mega Glalie's jaw is dislocated because of the overwhelming energy, causing its mouth to extend to the length of its face. The lower jaw is all black except for two light-blue, conical, icy spikes. The pupils in Mega Glalie's eyes are now red instead of black. The horns on top Mega Glalie's head have been partially turned into ice, with the addition of a third horn on its forehead.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains Ice type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Salamence
cardPool.value:
Salamence can Mega Evolve into Mega-Salamence using the Salamencite.
 Its wings fuse into a single massive crescent-shaped wing—hard yet flexible enough to function as deadly mid-air blades. Its body becomes sleeker, with a narrower face, neck, and torso, while its tail shortens for improved agility.
The ridges above its eyes diminish, and its lower jaw loses its thick gray scales, revealing smooth red flesh for enhanced aerodynamics. The upper fins on its head elongate into sharp points, while the middle set curves into quarter-arches that frame its snout. Its underbelly armor transforms into a segmented, vest-like frame, interlocking over its chest and shoulders when it tucks in its forelegs—perfect for high-speed dives and rapid maneuvers.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Dragon and Flying type.
cardPool.description: Salamence can Mega Evolve into Mega-Salamence using the Salamencite. As Mega Salamence, its wings meld together into a single huge, crescent-shaped wing. According to the anime, the hard, yet very flexible properties of its wings allow them to be used as blades in mid-air battles. Its face, neck, body and tail are narrower, and its tail is noticeably shorter in length. The ridges above its eyes are now far less prominent, and it no longer possesses the thick, gray scaling over its lower jaw. Instead, the smooth red flesh underneath has been left exposed, increasing its streamline appearance. The upper pair of fins resting on the sides of its head are now elongated and tapered. The lower pair has not changed much. However, the middle set now take the form of quarter-arches, spanning towards the bridge of the nose. The remnants of its shelled underbelly have been drastically transformed into a segmented, more aerodynamic, vest-like armored frame. This frame encases its chest and shoulders with the pieces interlocking whenever Mega Salamence tucks in its front forelegs. When it Mega Evolved, it is dual Dragon and Flying type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Metagross
cardPool.value:
Metagross can Mega Evolve into Mega-Metagross using the Metagrossite.
As Mega Metagross, it constantly floats, and its legs become arms. It also gains four legs on the back of its head. The cross on its face turns pale gold, and it gains two small holes and a spike immediately below the cross, giving the impression of a goatee.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Steel and Psychic type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Latias
cardPool.value:
Latias can Mega Evolve into Mega-Latias using the Latiasite.
As Mega Latias, the red parts of its body change to purple. Horns grow from the side of its head and run along its jaw. It loses the wings on its back and similar but larger wings attach to its lower arms, normally held in a level position. Triangle shapes now mark the forward point of its wings instead of its chest.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains Dragon and Psychic type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Latios
cardPool.value:
Latios can Mega Evolve into Mega-Latios using the Latiosite.
As Mega Latios, the blue parts of its body change to purple. Horns grow from the side of its head and run along its jaw. It loses the wings on its back and similar but larger wings attach to its lower arms, normally held in a level position. Triangle shapes now mark the forward point of its wings instead of its chest.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Dragon and Psychic type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Rayquaza
cardPool.value:
Unlike most Mega Evolutions, Rayquaza doesn't require a Mega Stone—instead, it achieves this transformation after learning the move Dragon Ascent.
As Mega Rayquaza, its body elongates, becoming even more serpentine and adorned with radiant golden embellishments. The Delta symbol manifests on its forehead, while its eyes shift to piercing yellow pupils surrounded by red irises. Black, shichishito-shaped markings trail behind its eyes, adding to its fearsome visage. Its once-red lips and teeth now gleam gold, connecting to its broadened lower horns, which flare into a triangular shape.
From these horns extend long, luminous golden tendrils, pulsing with energy as they stretch toward emerald-green fins. These tendrils bear ring patterns reminiscent of its normal form’s yellow markings, and when in flight, they create a striking Delta-shaped silhouette. Its upper horns lengthen, each tipped with a glowing orb and spike, while golden orbs now glow along its body where its rings once were.
Its underbelly darkens to black, contrasting with its emerald-green hide, which shimmers like polished jade. The fins along its body and tail become more pronounced, lined with gold and stretching dramatically longer. As it moves, energy particles cascade from its tendrils, leaving a trail of shimmering light.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Dragon and Flying type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Lopunny
cardPool.value:
Lopunny can Mega Evolve into Mega-Lopunny using the Lopunnite.
As Mega Lopunny, it sheds the fur on its neck, upper torso, fingers, and legs, forming black patterns on the legs that resembles ripped pantyhose. The tufts of fur above its eyes combine to form a single butterfly-shaped crest. The cream fur on its wrists and ankles becomes more round instead of fluffy. Its ear fur now only covers two segments of each ear in fluffy bands.
When it Mega Evolved, its type changed into dual Normal and Fighting type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Garchomp
cardPool.value:
Garchomp can Mega Evolve into Mega-Garchomp using the Garchompite.
When Garchomp Mega Evolves, several of its features become more angular, including its head and shoulders. A row of five tooth-like spikes sprouts from each side of its abdomen and red spikes grow from its knees. The claws and fins on its arms melt from the excessive Mega Evolution energy and morph together to form sharp, red blades.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Ground and Dragon type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Lucario
cardPool.value:
Lucario can Mega Evolve into Mega-Lucario using the Lucarionite.
As Mega Lucario, its cream fur becomes longer, and its thighs slim down. It develops more spikes on the back of its paws, which have turned crimson. It also develops spikes on both of its feet, which have become crimson too. Its previously red eyes are now orange-colored. Its aura-sensing appendages grow longer, and two of them are tipped in crimson. Its shoulders also possess a spike each. Its aura heightens throughout its body, which formed black markings on its blue fur.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Fighting and Steel type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Abomasnow
cardPool.value:
Abomasnow can Mega Evolve into Mega-Abomasnow using the Abomasite.
The sprouts on its back grow into great shafts of ice when this Pokémon Mega Evolves into Mega Abomasnow. Its fur becomes longer and shaggy over its entire body, particularly around its head. Green fur or sprout remnants surround the base of the large icicles on its back, while white fur covers the middle.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Grass and Ice type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Gallade
cardPool.value:
Gallade can Mega Evolve into Mega-Gallade using the Galladite.
As Mega Gallade, its entire body becomes white, save for its head. Red plates emerge from its arms, its blue head crest grows slightly longer, and the spikes on its head are elongated. It also gains two cape-like protrusions on its back, giving it a knightly appearance.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Psychic and Fighting type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Audino
cardPool.value:
Audino can Mega Evolve into Mega-Audino using the Audinite.
When Audino Mega Evolves into Mega Audino, it becomes both heavier and taller. The patterning on its stomach, now completely cream, is covered by what resembles a flared lab coat. Most of its body becomes white with pink tips in four places, one on each ear and near the edges of its "coat". Its eyes turn pink and its ears stand upright with longer, curlier feelers. Its tail becomes larger and a smaller tuft of fur is centered on its chest. Two additional, curled feelers extend from under this extra tuft of fur. White fur covers its feet with two small tufts on the heels.
When it Mega Evolved, its type changed into dual Normal and Fairy.

cardPool.title: Mega-Diancie
cardPool.value:
Diancie can Mega Evolve into Mega-Diancie using the Diancite.
As Mega Diancie, its white dress becomes longer and loses its sleeves. Its lower body turns into a pink crystal and is surrounded by a series of long crystals similar to those on its headdress. On the back, both the dress and the crystals are longer, and additional, smaller crystals are suspended from the tips of the larger ones. The tips of the circlet around its neck curve outward and there is an additional half-circlet around its waist. The centerpiece of its headdress is now heart-shaped, and the remaining crystals are slightly smaller. The crystals hanging from the sides of its head have additional crystals suspended from the tips, and there is an additional hanging crystal on the back of its head. The diamond on the back of its head becomes rounded and two smaller gems form at the lower corners. Two ribbon-like structures grow from these additional gems; each ribbon has two small crystals suspended from the tips.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Rock and Fairy type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Emboar
cardPool.value:
Emboar can Mega Evolve into Mega-Emboar using the Emboarite.
The wreath of flames on Emboar's neck expands and covers Mega Emboar's chest and shoulders like an armor; the flames are mostly red, with yellow marks around the chest and neck area. Its waist is covered in long red fur, and the combination of this fur with Mega Emboar's chest flames altogether resemble an angry face with an open mouth. Its tusks grow longer, with additional, smaller tusks on each side. The fur around its elbows also become longer, and it has red and yellow stripes on its arms and legs. Mega Emboar's eyebrows take on sharper, triangular shapes, accompanied by circular brows above each eye. It gains a tuft of hair on the back of its head, resembling a topknot.
Upon Mega Evolution, Emboar wields a blazing flame shaped like a serpentine spear, which is red with yellow in the middle. The upper half of the spear is more jagged than the bottom half, and the top of the spear is split into two tines that curve outward.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Fire and Fighting type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Feraligatr
cardPool.value:
Feraligatr can Mega Evolve into Mega-Feraligatr using the Feraligite.
Mega Feraligatr undergoes a dramatic transformation, with its back spikes evolving into a large, hood-like, dark red fin featuring serrated edges and false eyes. These false eyes are red with black sclerae, and their centers glow white when the hood fin is lowered. Additionally, Mega Feraligatr develops stubby red arm-like fins on its sides, a smaller back spike behind the hood fin, and two red ridge lines alongside it.
The uncovered scales on its shoulders, knees, and lower body transition to a blue-gray hue, while the V-shaped marking from its pre-evolved form shifts upward. The most notable feature is the false jaw mechanism, where the hood fin and arm spikes combine to form a massive false jaw. This is achieved by clasping its hands as the lower jaw and bringing down the hood as the upper jaw, resulting in a bite force ten times more powerful than its actual jaws. When the false jaw is closed, it strikingly resembles its pre-evolved form, Totodile.
When it Mega Evolved, its type changed into dual Water and Dragon.

cardPool.title: Mega-Meganium
cardPool.value:
Meganium can Mega Evolve into Mega-Meganium using the Meganiumite.
The singular six-petaled flower around Meganium's deck transforms into four flowers on Mega Meganium, which are colored, from top to bottom: red, dark pink, light pink, and white. The white flower has a red spiky pattern on three of its petals, branching radially from the center; the same pattern is present on the other three flowers, but colored white instead. The flowers on Mega Meganium are noticeably thicker than on regular Meganium. The bottoms of Mega Meganium's legs are covered in dark green frills that resemble leaves or foliage. The two stamen-like antennae on Meganium have transformed and fused into a V-shaped antenna on Mega Meganium, with each end curling near the tip.
When it Mega Evolved, its type changed into dual Grass and Fairy.

cardPool.title: Mega-Chesnaught
cardPool.value:
Chesnaught can Mega Evolve into Mega-Chesnaught using the Chesnaughtite.
As Mega Chesnaught, it more greatly resembles an armored warrior, and its torso is now completely covered in white fur. Its claws are now colored gold, matching a three-pronged, crown-like adornment on its head, with three black indentations. The armored plate covering its head has extended slightly downward to better resemble a helmet. The green and red bands on its shell have changed to a dark maroon color, matching a cape-like extension of fur underneath. The front connecting piece of its shell armor is now shaped like a spade and more beveled. Along with its front spines and arm spines, the latter of which have fully extended into sharp spikes, it is now a dark green color. Its shell also stores two shield-like extensions on the sides. Each extension has two spikes opposite each other on the rim, along with multiple green circular portions that can also extend into spikes, as well as a smaller spike on the top center of the extension. Mega Chesnaught can use its shell extensions like a battle axe.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Grass and Fighting type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Delphox
cardPool.value:
Delphox can Mega Evolve into Mega-Delphox using the Delphoxite.
As Mega Delphox, it more closely resembles a stereotypical witch on a broomstick. The ends of the flame-like fur in its ears have become darker, in addition to two long strips of black fur extending from the back of its head. The red fur of its "robe" and "sleeves" also take on a black gradient. The white fur on its chest and underside of its face have lengthened, resembling a long beard, while the yellow fur flanking its chest has receded. It sports a patch of flame-shaped red-orange fur on its forehead. Mega Delphox rides a large "broomstick", with a mass of flames serving as the broom's "head". It is flanked by two smaller flame-ended broomsticks that resemble a regular Delphox's fiery wand.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Fire and Psychic type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Greninja
cardPool.value:
Greninja can Mega Evolve into Mega-Greninja using the Greninjite.
As Mega Greninja, its body is now mostly black, except for its lower legs, upper arms, and hands, which retain the same color, making it appear as though it is wearing a ninja outfit. The fins on either side of its head have extended outward and turned light blue, resembling shuriken with one edge much longer than the others. The four-pointed star marks it had on its thighs have been replaced by actual water shurikens. Mega Greninja clings upside down to a giant, floating, and continually spinning six-pointed water shuriken it created from a gelatinous membrane secreted from its body. The shuriken levitates due to its high spinning speed.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Water and Dark type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Clefable
cardPool.value:
Clefable can Mega Evolve into Mega-Clefable using the Clefablite.
Mega Clefable's most distinct feature is its transformation into a large, pink creature with butterfly-like wings. The main color of the wings is dark pink, with yellow at the bottom; the wings' colors may change if Mega Clefable performs certain moves. Each wing extends from a three-pronged main structure coming out of Mega Clefable's back. Mega Clefable's ears are longer and droop beside its body; each ear is tube-shaped with a light blue circular opening at each tip. Mega Clefable also has two dark pink cheek marks on its face. Its eyes are half white and half light blue. Additionally, the curled lock of its hair transforms into a round, hat-like shape, with the lower half being pink and the upper half being white, topped with a curled tip.
When it Mega Evolved, its type changed into dual Fairy and Flying.

cardPool.title: Mega-Victreebel
cardPool.value:
Victreebel can Mega Evolve into Mega-Victreebel using the Victreebelite.
Mega Victreebel's body is massive compared to regular Victreebel, standing at almost three times its height and weighing over eight times as much. Its most distinctive feature is its bloated body, which is filled with large amounts of acid that Mega Victreebel creates thanks to the energy of Mega Evolution. The amount of acid in Mega Victreebel's body is so large that even closing its mouth is not enough to contain it, so it has to wrap its throat with its own elongated vine in order to prevent the acid from spilling out. Other notable physical features of Mega Victreebel include green leaves with orange tips on the sides of its body, and three large leaves on the tip of its vine hovering over its head, which also have orange tips.
When it Mega Evolved, it remains dual Grass and Poison type.

cardPool.title: Mega-Starmie
cardPool.value:
